data.title: 1H 2020 Transparency Report Statistics
data.content:
The total number of government requests for communication data on our services was 201, which was not significantly different from the second half of 2019 (199). Kakao has not provided communication data since the first half of 2013. 
If any data for communication-restricting measures is requested for Daum services, only certain part of data is provided after a thorough review based on legal standards, while we do not provide any data on the above measures in the case of Kakao services. 
The number of requests for communication data related to Daum services has decreased by 16.5% compared to the second half of 2019, and the number of cases processed has also decreased by 20%. In case of Kakao services, the number of such cases has both increased by 5.7% and 4.8%, respectively, compared to the same period. 
The number of requests for Daum services based on a warrant of seizure and search has decreased by 4.5% compared to the second half of 2019. Meanwhile, the number of requests for Kakao services has increased by 27.4% compared to the second half of 2019. Kakao strives to provide only minimum information that meets the requirements.
